Global Food Prices Reach Three-Year High Amid Supply Shocks

Global food prices have risen to a three-year high, driven by climate shocks and the war in Ukraine which have tightened supplies. The Economic Times reported that these factors are contributing to the increase. Separately, the Evening Standard noted a tumble in UK food exports due to high costs and impacts from the Middle East.
